prompt:
Create a production background for a 2D overhead pixel-art exploration RPG: the small entrance square of a half-abandoned old American harbor neighborhood on an overcast late afternoon. Grounded, wistful, lived-in, beautifully detailed but readable. This is a FLAT ORTHOGRAPHIC GAME MAP, parallel vertical and horizontal edges, camera looking steeply downward like classic top-down JRPGs. NO perspective vanishing point, NO isometric diamond, NO horizon, no distant skyline. Fine consistent pixel-art clusters and restrained dark outlines, muted sage masonry, gray-brown paving, oxidized teal trim, warm amber window glints. Not a painted watercolor or photorealistic render. Canvas 768x1152.
LAYOUT CONTRACT: a rectangular flat walkable square spans x112..656, y64..1088. Both long edges are strictly parallel; the bottom has the SAME width as the top. Ground remains at a single level. Keep this ENTIRE floor free of solid furniture, buildings, trees or steps. On the floor add only flat details: varied SMALL paving stones about 16-24 pixels wide, subtle repaired brick patches, worn walking paths, uneven weather staining, a few tiny weeds along cracks, scattered dry leaves and one or two paper scraps, small thin damp patches. No giant paving slabs, no dominant repetitive checker pattern. Lighter worn route threads naturally from the bottom center toward the two shops and north alley, without painted arrows.
Buildings exist ONLY OUTSIDE the floor rectangle: narrow cutaway facade strips at x0..112 and x656..768. Never project any roofs/furniture into the floor. Left border: weathered watch-repair storefront with dark moss green woodwork, a small wall-mounted clock, dusty window panes and old brick foundation. RIGHT border: faded indigo photo studio with old display window and a few faded monochrome photographs behind glass. Along non-door facade margins add a drainpipe, a chipped planter and stacked tiny obsolete signboards, all wholly outside the walkable floor. Leave ONE clear side entrance gap in the LEFT boundary centered at y320, about104px tall, and ONE in the RIGHT boundary at y472, about104px tall; bare thresholds without door panels, runtime adds door panels. Top edge y0..64: low weathered brick boundary with an OPEN alley gap x334..434 centered at x384. Bottom center remains open for arrival. No other entrances or tempting unreachable side paths. Avoid all readable text, no letters, no UI, no characters, no free-standing interactive props. Atmosphere comes from surface history, warm windows, low soft afternoon shadows and facade detail. Retain clear ground contrast for a small yellow-jacket player.
